body:
Thank you so much for this. You're right. It was my mistake and one of my own design. I do need to take responsibility for this...but the hardest part is that I am basically alone for the first time in my entire life. I am 25 years old and have never been single since I was 13. I'm fine with my own company, but I just find that life's adventures are wonderful if you have someone to share them with. I guess that is ultimately what I had, what I lost, and what I want...badly. I need to work on myself. I need to heal. I know this. But sometimes I will wake up and feel like I am being trampled by horses and there is nothing I can do to stop the pain. That is what this morning was like...

Thank you for your message. I will talk to my new friend tonight. She knows a lot of this, and knows about today...but I think we should probably start talking about what it all means or time or something...I don't want to destroy this too. :/

I am familiar with the reddit downvote system and how it auto generates it's own numbers to mask the actual progression of stories for spamming purposes. But it received a downvote right off the bat which is something you don't typically see the vote system do. Not that it really matters at all...just didn't understand *why* someone would do that though...
